## filter only selected  

table2viz <- data$full_toptable %>% select( Precursor.Id, usage_logFC, usage_se, usage_pval, usage_adjPval,Protein.Group, Genes, pep_type ,start, end )
table2viz <- table2viz %>% rename( PrecursorID= Precursor.Id,
                                    logFC = usage_logFC,
                                    SE = usage_se,
                                    Pval = usage_pval,
                                    adjPval = usage_adjPval,
                                    ProteinGroup = Protein.Group,
                                    Peptype =pep_type, 
                                    Start = start,
                                    End = end
                                  )

# DT::datatable( table2viz %>% arrange(usage_adjPval)  ,
#              extensions = c('FixedColumns', 'Scroller'),
#              options = list(fixedColumns = TRUE, scrollY = 400, scrollX = TRUE,
#                             scroller = TRUE, dom = 'Bfrtip', autoWidth = TRUE
#              ),
#  ) %>%  formatRound(columns=c('usage_logFC'), digits=2) %>%
#   formatSignif(columns = c('usage_pval', 'usage_adjPval'), digits = 2) 
# 1. Prepare data (preserving your sorting)
 table2viz_sorted <- table2viz %>% arrange(adjPval)


#   
# # 2. Render Reactable
tab_ <- reactable(
  table2viz_sorted,
  # Layout & Scroller features
  pagination = TRUE,       # If you want the infinite scroll/scroller feel
  highlight = TRUE,         # Highlights row on hover
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,           # Alternating row colors
  compact = TRUE,           # Smaller padding (cleaner for large tables)
  searchable = TRUE,        # Adds the search box
  resizable = TRUE,         # Allows manual column resizing

  rowStyle = function(index) {
    row_data <- table2viz_sorted[index, ]
    # 1. Grab the values for this specific row using the index
    # Replace 'usage_adjPval' and 'usage_logFC' with your actual colA and colB names
    is_poi <- row_data$ProteinGroup %in% pe$poi
    is_sig <- !is.na(row_data$adjPval) && row_data$adjPval < pe$adjPval_thr
    is_fc  <- !is.na(row_data$logFC) && abs(row_data$logFC) > pe$FC_thr
    # Highlight POIs that are also significant
    if (is_poi && is_sig && is_fc) {
    return(list(background = "#9ee690", fontWeight = "bold")) # Light Green for "Success"
    }
  },
  # Column Definitions (Rounding, Significance, and Fixing)
  columns = list(
    # FIXED COLUMN (Sticky)
    PrecursorID = colDef(
      sticky = "left",
      minWidth = 200, # Set length here
      style = list(borderRight = "1px solid #eee"),
      headerStyle = list(borderRight = "1px solid #eee")
    ),
    
    # ROUNDING (2 decimal places) for $usage\_logFC$
    logFC = colDef(
      width = 100,
      format = colFormat(digits = 2)
    ),
    SE = colDef(
      width = 100,
      format = colFormat(digits = 2)
    ),
    # SIGNIFICANT DIGITS (2 sig figs) for $usage\_pval$
    Pval = colDef(
      width = 100,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return("-")
        # formatC with "g" handles significant digits and scientific notation automatically
        formatC(value, digits = 2, format = "g")
      }
    ),
    # SIGNIFICANT DIGITS for $usage\_adjPval$
    adjPval = colDef(
      width = 100,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return("-")
        formatC(value, digits = 2, format = "g")
      }
    )
  )
  
)

tagList(tab_)
